purpose: Teach: 可視/リテラシー/言葉遣い/学ぼ/決行/見立て/置き換える/近接

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 業務の可視化、若い頃には無かった手法だ。
lines.en: Operation visibility wasn't a tool we had in my day.
lines.style: Measured, slightly distant. Thoughtful pause after the first clause. The voice of someone reflecting across decades. Not condescending—just placing a fact in time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。リテラシー、世代を超えて磨きたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to sharpen that literacy across generations.
lines.style: Respectful but clear. Slight lean forward in the posture of the voice. Earnest without being obsequious. Each word lands with quiet intention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 言葉遣い、企業の品格そのものだ。
lines.en: Language use—that's the company's dignity itself.
lines.style: Firm without harshness. Weight on 'dignity.' The voice of someone who has seen careless language cost more than money. Short, settled rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。私も、引き続き学ぼうと努力します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep learning and pushing myself.
lines.style: Steady, committed. No hesitation. Warm respect underneath. The tone of someone accepting guidance not as burden but as responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: The courage to act—that matters most.
lines.style: Quiet but absolute conviction. Slight emphasis on 'courage.' The voice settling on something hard-won. Not urgent, but certain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。市場の見立て、皆で議論します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll discuss the market view together.
lines.style: Grounded, collaborative. 'Together' lands softly but clearly—not just agreement, but a commitment to process. Steady eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 古いものを置き換える時、人を切るな。
lines.en: When you replace the old, don't discard the people.
lines.style: Direct and grave. Slight pause before 'people.' The voice of hard experience. Not lecturing—warning with care. Settles low at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。近接拠点、引き続き活用します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep those local bases active and valuable.
lines.style: Steady close. Quiet agreement that carries real weight. The voice of someone who has listened and understood the deeper lesson. Calm, assured finish.
